title: Lashkare shah Ke Alamdar
body:
Lashkar-e-shah Ke Alamdar
Abbas Abbas Abbas
Pisare Hyder-e-karrar
Wo Shabahat Mein Ali Wo Shujahat Mein Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo Ibadat Mein Ali Wo Saqawat Mein Ali
Misle Hyder Wahi Kirdar Abbas
Murtuza Ka Wo Pisar Jung Me Sina Wo Sifar
Bani Hasham Ka Qamar Shahe Wo Noore Nazar
<<DIVIDER>>
Hazrate Ahmed E Muqtar Abbas
Ek Samundar Ki Tarha Mouje Kousar Ki Tarha
Jung-e-hyder Ki Tarha Ek Lashkar Ki Tarha
Foujhe Islam Ke Sardar Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
Qabza Dariya Pa Kiya Pani Chullu Mein Liya Aur Phir Pyasa Raha Hae Wo Teri Wafa
Dekhna Pani Ko Ek Bar Abbas
Dashat Me Shah-e- Zaman Aur Tapta Huwa Ban
Chur Zakmoun Se Baadan Bekaso Tashna Dahan
<<DIVIDER>>
Lee Qabar Apne Abbas Abbas
De Sakina Ne Sada Aao Dariya Se Chacha
Shimr Karta Hai Jafa Sar Se Chini Hai Rida
Ghashme Hai Abed-e- Bimar Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab Aisiri Hai Sitam Sar Hai Naizou Pe Alam
Berida Honge Haram Nange Sar Jayenge Hum
Hum Phirenge Sare Bazar Abbas
Ab To Akbar Bhi Nahi Hai Asghar Nahi Nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Qasim Bhi Nahi Zainda Sarwar Bhi Nahi
Ham Hai Aur Sham Ka Darbar Abbas
